3.title:

content.string:
That, on the recommendation of the Managing
  Director of Environmental and Engineering Services and City Engineer, the
  following actions be taken with respect to the single source purchase of
  APG-Neuro blowers for the Greenway wastewater treatment plant:
 
a)         the
  price submitted by APG-Neuros of $2,240,000.00, excluding H.S.T., for the
  supply of 6 blowers and associated components, BE ACCEPTED;  
 
b)         the
  financing for these acquisitions BE APPROVED as set out in the Sources of
  Financing Report appended to the staff report dated August 22, 2016, as
  Appendix "A";
 
c)         the
  Civic Administration BE AUTHORIZED to undertake all administrative acts that
  are necessary in connection with this project; 
 
d)         the
  approvals given herein BE CONDITIONAL upon the Corporation entering into a
  formal contract for the work to be done relating to this project; and,
 
e)         the
  Mayor and the City Clerk BE AUTHORIZED to execute any contract or other
  documents, if required, to give effect to these recommendations.  (2016-F18)
